texts.zh: 在对[fromfrom.planet.GetName]的扫描中发现在这颗行星最难以靠近的区域有一座孤立的设施。这座结构似乎正在休眠或已被抛弃，其中没有任何能量迹象，看起来也饱经风霜。进行考古发掘可能会带来更深入的洞见。
texts.en: Scans of [fromfrom.planet.GetName] discovered an isolated facility in the planet's most inaccessible region. The structure appears to be dormant or abandoned, with no energy signature and signs of prolonged weathering. An archaeological expedition may yield further insight.

sections.zh: 在对[fromfrom.planet.GetName]的扫描中发现在这颗行星最难以靠近的区域有一座孤立的设施。这座结构似乎正在休眠或已被抛弃，其中没有任何能量迹象，看起来也饱经风霜。进行考古发掘可能会带来更深入的洞见。
sections.en: Scans of [fromfrom.planet.GetName] discovered an isolated facility in the planet's most inaccessible region. The structure appears to be dormant or abandoned, with no energy signature and signs of prolonged weathering. An archaeological expedition may yield further insight.

texts.zh:
该设施的内部包含了无数被废弃的医疗机械、治疗舱室和一个太平间。太平间的储藏荚舱里发现有一些部分保存完好的有机遗骸有疾患和病变的迹象。安全门、监视设备和拘留室的存在让[universal_macrophage_scientist.GetName]得出结论，有些个体是被强行关押在这里的。

我们取回了一些设备部件，但绝大部分都腐坏严重。电脑系统中残存的数据有限，我们虽然恢复了一些文件但仍有待翻译。
texts.en:
The facility's interior contains a myriad of abandoned medical machines, treatment chambers, and a morgue. In the cadaver storage pods, we found partially-preserved organic remains with signs of disease and deformation. The presence of security doors, surveillance rigs, and holding cells has led [universal_macrophage_scientist.GetName] to conclude that some were kept here against their will.

We salvaged a few equipment parts but almost everything has decayed markedly. Limited data remained on the computer systems; we recovered some files but they require translation.

texts.zh:
[universal_macrophage_scientist.GetName]提交了一份从[fromfrom.planet.GetName]的设施里恢复的数据资料的部分翻译。

17号实验室——进度汇报——研究主任吉列伯

新的原型展现出了一些初步的潜力。对象的免疫系统增强了数百万倍，而且所有的病原体都已被清除。副作用依旧存在：紧随其后的致命突变，无一幸免。会再做尝试。我很确信，万能巨噬细胞已经成功在望了。
texts.en:
[universal_macrophage_scientist.GetName] produced a partial translation for one of the data files recovered from the facility on [fromfrom.planet.GetName].

Lab 17 - Progress update - Research Lead Gelebor

The new prototype showed initial promise. Subjects' immune systems boosted millionfold and all pathogens were eradicated. Side effects persisted: fatal mutations followed, no survivors. Will try again. The Universal Macrophage is within our reach, I am sure of it.

texts.zh:
[universal_macrophage_scientist.GetName]翻译了从[fromfrom.planet.GetName]上的废弃实验室取回的另一份文件。

17号实验室——内部员工笔记——研究主任吉列伯

同事们，项目终止命令今天来了；宗主已经没耐心了。但我们离目标就只差一步！万能巨噬细胞比任何人的突发奇想都重要。我们可以拥有一个没有疾病的未来！为了取得这样的进步，多牺牲几个生命的代价又有多大呢？

如果他们不送来更多的实验对象——我就在我自己身上做实验。你们要和我一起吗？
texts.en:
[universal_macrophage_scientist.GetName] translated another file from the abandoned laboratory on [fromfrom.planet.GetName].

Lab 17 - Internal staff memo - Research Lead Gelebor

Colleagues, the project termination order came today; the overlord's patience is at an end. And yet we are so close to our goal! The Universal Macrophage is more important than the whims of any one individual. A disease-free future can be ours! What is the small cost of a few more lives for such progress?

If they don't send more trial subjects - I will test the latest prototype on myself. Will you join me?

texts.zh:
[universal_macrophage_scientist.GetName]翻译了[fromfrom.planet.GetName]上生物实验室的电脑里的最后一份日志。

17号实验室——最终汇报——科研助理菲力多

我们盲目地跟随着的就是这个吉列伯的自信。

在我们自己身上测试原型，免疫系统一开始得到了增强；我们几乎可以免疫一切外部病原体。然后突变就开始了。

吉列伯先死了。死状惨不忍睹。现在整个团队都躺在了在太平间里，我也很快就会加入他们。

我们失败了。我们把自己的性命托付给了吉列伯的错误配方。万能巨噬细胞功能过于强大——它最终会攻击宿主自身。这里的一切东西都必须销毁。
texts.en:
[universal_macrophage_scientist.GetName] translated the final log entry from the bio lab's computers on [fromfrom.planet.GetName].

Lab 17 - Final Report - Research Assistant Filidor

Such was Gelebor's confidence that we followed him blindly.

Testing the prototype on ourselves, our immune systems were initially bolstered; we were nigh invincible to any outside pathogens. Then the mutations started.

Gelebor perished first. It was difficult to watch. Now the whole team is resting in the morgue and I will soon join them.

We failed. We trusted our lives to Gelebor's flawed formula. The Universal Macrophage works too well - it eventually attacks the host itself. Everything here must be destroyed.

label.zh: 继续完成吉列伯的工作，这看起来很有希望。
label.en: Complete Gelebor's work. It holds promise.

label.zh: 这种有缺陷的研究也是能堪一用的。
label.en: This flawed research can be put to use.

label.zh: 我们是突变的主宰。让我们完成这工作。
label.en: We are masters of Mutation. Let us finish the work.

label.zh: 我们是突变的主宰。让我们完成这工作。
label.en: We are masters of Mutation. Let us finish the work.
